theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Elite Athleticism & Precision)
theme_and_archetype.description: Tactical Minimalism tailored for a mobile-first sports prediction game. High contrast, energetic feel with deep blacks and striking electric accents.
theme_and_archetype.domain: Sports, App Dashboard, Mobile-First Web App

typography.rules: Avoid generic headers. Use wide fluid scale for readability.

colors.contrast_rules: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Use Text Shadow over images. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first approach. All components must fit narrow viewports beautifully.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: p-4 and p-6 for mobile containers; p-8 for desktop layouts. Use gap-4 for dense widgets.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid: grid-cols-1 on mobile, md:grid-cols-3 on desktop. Ensure h-full for children so bento cards stretch evenly.
layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use 1px solid strokes (border-white/10) instead of soft shadows. Sharp radii (rounded-none to rounded-md max).

components_strategy.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react. Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react. Use Duotone or Bold weights for athletic feel.
components_strategy.flags: MANDATORY: Use react-country-flag. Command: yarn add react-country-flag. Render SVG format everywhere a team is shown. Layout: [Flag] [Team Name] (e.g., 🇸🇪 Sweden).
components_strategy.forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to dark mode. Strip Vercel look, add 1px sharp borders and neon focus states.
components_strategy.tabs: Override Shadcn fixed heights (h-auto). Use for 'Live Points', 'Strategy Points', 'Total Points' Leaderboard tabs.
components_strategy.cards: Cardless or 'technical' grid look. Matches should look like tactical data rows rather than floating cards.
components_strategy.tournament_bracket: Use horizontal scroll overflow (overflow-x-auto) on mobile. Use technical connector lines (border-t border-r) to link advancing teams. Highlight predicted winners with accent_primary text/borders.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: ALWAYS set hover:text-white and hover:border-white/30. Active/Selected state gets primary accent border.

hero_login.description: Aerial night football stadium. Apply bg-black/70 overlay. Use for Login/Register.

leaderboard_header.description: Cheering fans for leaderboard background. Apply heavy dark gradient to transparent to maintain text legibility.

dashboard_accent.description: Soccer ball on grass for empty states or generic sports accents.

accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, and prediction cards MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-prediction-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over images is readable using heavy overlays or text-shadow.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Family World Cup 2026', a private prediction web app.
Tech Stack: React JS (use .js/.jsx, NOT TypeScript .tsx per critical rules), Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI, Supabase.
Enforce the 'Performance Pro' dark theme. Avoid standard generic SaaS styles.
Implement navigation between Login, Register, Dashboard, Matches, Leaderboard, Tournament Prediction, and Admin pages.
Leaderboard must prominently feature the three point columns: Live Points, Strategy Points, Total Points.
Every mention of a team name MUST include its SVG flag using react-country-flag.
Use Phosphor icons for standard iconography.
Ensure the entire app is strictly mobile-first. Test padding, grid spans, and typography scaling for narrow viewports.
Include data-testid on every clickable element.
